verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents project-level real-time notifications to email, Slack and PagerDuty, and its webhooks fire on the same triggers as the other channels, so project-scoped routing to the named destinations is covered. Nothing in the pack shows environment or severity filters on rules, or per-rule thresholds for new issues, frequency spikes or affected-user counts. Person tracking exists, but it is not shown as an alert trigger. Missing for 10: documented environment/severity rule filters, documented trigger types (new item, frequency/rate spike, affected-user threshold), per-rule threshold configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can route alerts by project, environment, and severity to Slack, PagerDuty, or email with per-rule thresholds — new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count

citations.quote: Rollbar supports email and many messaging and incident management tools where your team can get notified about errors and important events by real-time alerts.
Rollbar provides real-time alerts through the project-level Notifications menu.
Rollbar can create, update, and resolve Incidents in PagerDuty.
Webhooks can be sent for the same triggers as our other notifications channels
